text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest open PR first. This surfaces routing flaws fastest by testing the live system where changes matter most. The trade-off is delayed validation for older PRs, but fresh data beats stale checks.

name: Gauge
text: Shadow mode on the newest open PR risks exposing *new* edge cases that could destabilize the PR’s core—fresh routing paths haven’t been stress-tested by prior merges. Instead, run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the oldest merged PR first; stale routing paths are already validated, so we catch regressions without risking live PRs. Settle it by measuring shadow mode impact on CI failure rates for both approaches over two sprints.

name: Overhaul
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on *both* the oldest merged PR and the newest open PR in parallel—this doubles validation coverage without adding delay. The trade-off is higher compute cost, but it reduces risk by catching regressions in live routing paths while still stress-testing new ones.
